what: D4 confidence recalibration of the v2 agent + accuracy analytics (no device, no retrain)

outputs.rows.json: one row per device answer (onset age as features_v2.go onsetAge, prompt numbers, truth)
outputs.calibration_metrics.json: CV on fit set (variants x shrinkage A), held-out metrics, bootstrap CI
outputs.table_cells.md: per (pattern, age) cell: fit k/m, Wilson CI, table value, held-out k/m
outputs.reliability.svg: reliability diagram, CV and held-out, model vs D4
outputs.confidence_recal_v2.go.txt: the generated Go table (also written into features_v2.go)
outputs.analytics.md / analytics.json: per role / sensor / month / pattern errors, 3 h app chain, status & cause analysis
